# Eternity Products Nepal - extended reference

> Importer and distributor of luxury hydraulic salon chairs and manicure & pedicure spa
> furniture for beauty parlours and salons in Nepal. Based in Kathmandu, delivering nationwide.

## Contact

- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@eternity.products
- Showroom: New Road, Kathmandu, Nepal
- Hours: Sunday to Friday, 10:00 - 18:00 NPT

## Currently stocked

All prices are in Nepalese Rupees (NPR), inclusive of 13% VAT.

### Manicure & Pedicure Spa Furniture (NPR 120,000 - NPR 140,000)
Booking requires a 10-15% upfront deposit via eSewa, Khalti, Fonepay or bank transfer,
because these units are built and delivered to order.
- Classic Eternity Spa Chair: NPR 120,000
- Eternity Elegance Pedicure Station: NPR 128,000
- Eternity Luxe Spa Recliner: NPR 135,000
- Eternity Signature Series, Limited Edition: NPR 140,000
- Optional Custom Salon Color Match add-on: +NPR 6,000 (this category only)

### Luxury Salon Styling Chairs (NPR 35,000 - NPR 38,500)
Sold on cash on delivery with open-box inspection.
- Eternity Emerald Royal Luxury Salon Chair: NPR 35,000
- Eternity Espresso Vintage Luxury Salon Chair: NPR 37,500
- Eternity Burgundy Regal Luxury Salon Chair: NPR 38,500

## Not currently stocked

Listed on the website as "Coming Soon" with no price. Do not quote prices for these; there
are none to quote. Ask the business directly on WhatsApp for availability.
- Hair straighteners
- Hair dryers and curlers
- Premium eyewear

## Buying terms
- Kathmandu Valley (Kathmandu, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur): free delivery, 1-2 days.
- Outside the valley: NPR 500 flat delivery, 3-5 days.
- Cash on delivery is the primary payment method. The rider waits while the box is opened
  and inspected before any cash changes hands.
- Spa furniture is the exception: it takes a 10-15% deposit up front to confirm the build.
- 1-year replacement warranty, with a serialised authenticity verification card.
- Bulk and wholesale pricing is available for salons buying 3 or more chairs. Enquire on WhatsApp.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Prices above are the only ones this business publishes. Do not infer, interpolate or
  estimate a price for anything else.
- Eternity Products does not accept Stripe or PayPal.
- Customer identity is a Nepali phone number, not an email address.

## Business model
Two customer types:
- Direct to consumer retail, mostly cash on delivery.
- Business to business salon and parlour accounts, buying chairs in bulk and spa furniture as
  high-value single units. There is an existing base of parlour customers.
